summary: System has lifecycle tools (register, evolve, debug) and boredom manager, but lacks automated triggers to invoke them during normal operation

components.currentBehavior: Manual tool that registers templates via MCP when explicitly invoked. Supports validation before registration and auto-registration hooks.
components.desiredBehavior: Should be automatically invoked when new templates are created if config.metabob.template_auto_registration.enabled=true and strategy='on-create'
components.gap: Auto-registration exists but only works for templates created via ActivityTemplate.create(). Need to ensure all template creation paths trigger auto-registration.

components.currentBehavior: Helper function that checks config and auto-registers templates on create/save/load triggers. Already implemented and working.
components.desiredBehavior: Continue working as-is. This is correct implementation.
components.gap: No gap - this is working correctly. Confirmed by test coverage in template-auto-registration.test.ts

components.currentBehavior: Detects idle sessions (5min), fetches boredom activities from metabob_fetch_boredom_activities MCP tool, executes highest priority activity. Activities have type 'improve-template' | 'debug-failures' | 'optimize-performance' but these are just labels, not automatic template invocations.
components.desiredBehavior: When boredom activity type='improve-template', should automatically invoke evolve-activity-self-contained template with templateId from boredom activity. When type='debug-failures', should invoke debug-activity-self-contained with failed execution context.
components.gap: CRITICAL GAP: executeBoredomActivity() calls executeActivityInline() but passes templateId from boredom activity directly. If backend returns improve-template/debug-failures as activity_type, it should map to evolve-activity-self-contained/debug-activity-self-contained templates instead.

components.currentBehavior: Registers pre/post turn hooks for memory-management, activity-recommendation-injection, metabob-context-preparation, post-turn-cleanup, session-memory-optimization, impulse-learning-init, impulse-learning-flush. No hooks for template evolution or debugging.
components.desiredBehavior: Add post-activity-completion hook that checks if activity failed repeatedly (>3 times) and auto-triggers debug-activity-self-contained. Add periodic hook (e.g., daily or weekly) that checks template staleness and triggers evolve-activity-self-contained.
components.gap: CRITICAL GAP: No lifecycle hooks for template evolution or automatic debugging. Need to add hooks that monitor activity failures and template staleness.

components.currentBehavior: Executes activities, auto-enables trailblazing for meta-templates (create/evolve/debug-activity), injects similar activity context for meta-templates. Saves activity status as 'done' or 'failed' but no follow-up actions on failure.
components.desiredBehavior: After activity fails, should check failure count for that template. If >3 failures in last 24h, should auto-trigger debug-activity-self-contained with the failed activityId.
components.gap: CRITICAL GAP: No automatic debugging trigger on activity failure. Activity.save() is called with status='failed' but no subsequent analysis or debugging is triggered.

components.currentBehavior: Has template_auto_registration config with enabled, behavior (strict/best-effort), and strategy (on-create/on-save/on-load/on-first-use/never). Has activity_learning config with enabled, record_outcomes, track_decisions, track_impulses.
components.desiredBehavior: Add template_lifecycle_automation config with fields: auto_evolve_on_staleness (boolean), staleness_threshold_days (number), auto_debug_on_failure (boolean), failure_threshold_count (number), max_evolution_frequency_hours (number).
components.gap: CRITICAL GAP: No configuration for automated template lifecycle (evolution, debugging). Need to add config schema to control when/how templates are automatically improved.

components.currentBehavior: Self-contained template that fetches template + metrics from backend, identifies improvements, applies changes, validates, and registers improved version. Works when manually invoked.
components.desiredBehavior: Should be automatically invoked by boredom-manager when template becomes stale (low success rate, not used recently, high failure rate).
components.gap: Template exists and works, but is not automatically invoked. Need boredom-manager to map 'improve-template' activity type to this template.

components.currentBehavior: Self-contained template that uses activity_error_inspector MCP tool to analyze failed executions, generates fix recommendations. Works when manually invoked.
components.desiredBehavior: Should be automatically invoked when an activity fails repeatedly (>3 times in 24h) to diagnose the problem and suggest fixes.
components.gap: Template exists and works, but is not automatically invoked on repeated failures. Need to add failure tracking and auto-trigger logic in activity.ts or turn-lifecycle-hooks.ts.

components.currentBehavior: Calls metabob_register_activity_template MCP tool to register templates with backend. Used by TemplateRepository.save() which is called by maybeAutoRegisterWithMetabob().
components.desiredBehavior: Continue working as-is. This is the correct MCP abstraction.
components.gap: No gap - MCP integration is correct.

currentState.templateRegistration: User creates template → ActivityTemplate.create() → maybeAutoRegisterWithMetabob() → TemplateRepository.save() → MetabobCLI.registerActivityTemplate() → metabob_register_activity_template MCP tool
currentState.boredomSystem: Idle detection (5min) → BoredomManager.fetchBoredomActivities() → metabob_fetch_boredom_activities MCP tool → returns activities with type/priority/metrics → BoredomManager.executeBoredomActivity() → executeActivityInline() with templateId from boredom activity
currentState.activityFailure: Activity fails → activity.status = 'failed' → Activity.save() → END (no follow-up action)
currentState.templateEvolution: Manual invocation only → User runs 'opencode activity evolve-activity-self-contained --variables {...}'

desiredState.boredomSystem: Idle detection → fetchBoredomActivities() → Map activity_type to template: 'improve-template' → 'evolve-activity-self-contained', 'debug-failures' → 'debug-activity-self-contained' → executeActivityInline() with mapped templateId + variables from metrics → Template auto-improved
desiredState.activityFailure: Activity fails → Check failure count for templateId in last 24h → If >3 failures → Auto-trigger debug-activity-self-contained with {executionId: failedActivityId} → Debug analysis created → Notify user
desiredState.templateEvolution: EITHER: Boredom system triggers (idle + stale template) OR: Post-activity hook triggers (after N executions, check if template should evolve) OR: Manual invocation (existing path, keep for ad-hoc use)

architecturalNotes.mcpAbstraction: All lifecycle operations already use MCP abstraction correctly (metabob_register_activity_template, metabob_fetch_boredom_activities, activity_error_inspector). No direct HTTP calls to RPC API.
architecturalNotes.existingPatterns: Auto-registration pattern (maybeAutoRegisterWithMetabob) provides good model for lifecycle automation. BoredomManager provides infrastructure for idle-time work. Turn lifecycle hooks provide integration points.
architecturalNotes.bootstrapTemplates: evolve-activity-self-contained and debug-activity-self-contained are bootstrap templates (embedded in code, always available). They use MCP tools and are fully self-contained (no git history required).
architecturalNotes.trailblazing: Meta-templates (create/evolve/debug-activity) automatically enable trailblazing mode for dynamic task creation. This is already implemented in ActivityTool.execute():975-990.
